about: Role contract for the protected commit gate (boundary rules 1, 2 and 4; S2b, wv-7ee8fe). The gate reads HEAD's copy, never the candidate's. enforcement: path prefixes whose files the gate runs from HEAD's protected copy; each changed file under one is also judged in its own lane, which holds it as staged with HEAD's other files. invoking: files that decide how suites run or whether a recorded result is reused, including every library loaded into the hook's shell, whose environment the suites inherit; a lane changing one reruns its suites. entry_points: the git hooks among the enforcement files and the event each serves; a lane runs only the pre-commit hook, so a commit changing another entry point is refused until a repair record can admit it (S2c). external: repository paths outside enforcement that enforcement files name through REPO_ROOT, each with the role it plays. check_authority: for each check a lane may share, the external enforcement files only that check reads; each is copied for that check alone and is absent from every other stage (R-a, wv-a75d98), so a lane changing one reruns its check and shares the protected pass's suite results.

external..weave: graph and gate configuration, read from the frozen candidate
external..weave/gate-provision.json: suite provisioning and adoption from the protected base; candidate declaration validated before mode selection
external..weave/test-map.conf: suite routing, read from the frozen candidate
external..weave/test-map-retired.conf: retired suites, read from the frozen candidate
external..venv/bin/python3: mutable checkout interpreter for consumer focused pytest only; never used for self-hosting frozen execution or reusable readiness
external..venv/bin: ruff and pyrefly for the pre-commit Python checks in Weave's own tree (wv-e7a3b2): they read the frozen staged tree and never execute it, the trust a tool found on PATH already has; the interpreter beside pyrefly supplies site-packages only
external.tests/lib/run-pytest.sh: focused pytest suite identifier only; execution and locked provisioning belong to the protected backend and policy
external.tests/weave_indexer: python test package from the frozen candidate
external.tests/weave_quality: python test package from the frozen candidate
external..weave/procedures: repository-owned procedures, read by wv guide and wv doctor outside the gate
external..weave/guides: repository-owned coaching guides, read by wv memory review, wv doctor and coaching outside the gate
external..weave/patterns: repository-owned detectors, read by wv memory review and wv quality outside the gate
external.mcp/contract.json: MCP contract, read by wv commands outside the gate
external.mcp/dist/index.js: MCP build output, read by wv commands outside the gate
